local_adaptations.reason: _UNQUALIFIED_DEPENDENCY_CLAIM_PATTERNS's self-contained-noun exclusion list widened (illustration/demo/demonstration/walkthrough/showcase/script) after a real false positive: aspose-cells-foss/Python's candidate described its example as a 'self-contained illustration', which the narrower upstream list did not exclude, wrongly flagging a claim about the example code as an absolute dependency-absence claim about the product. Verified by test at landing time.

check_process_narration_smells() replaced one combined alternation regex with per-pattern regexes plus a leftmost/earliest-pattern non-overlapping reduction (_find_process_narration_matches), removing catastrophic alternation backtracking on long READMEs. Match semantics are preserved: sorting candidates by (start, pattern_index, end) reproduces the combined regex's leftmost-then-first-alternative choice, and consumed_until reproduces its post-match scan advance. The landing commit did not re-pin this manifest, which is the drift this entry closes.

_UNQUALIFIED_DEPENDENCY_CLAIM_PATTERNS's self-contained-noun exclusion list widened again to cover 'pattern' after a real false positive: aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose.PDF-FOSS-for-.NET's Quick Start prose described its introductory example as 'the minimal, self-contained pattern for getting started', which the exclusion list (already covering example/snippet/sample/version/illustration/demo/demonstration/walkthrough/showcase/script) did not yet cover, wrongly flagging a claim about the example code as an absolute dependency-absence claim about the product. Verified by test at landing time.

_GENERIC_ACRONYM_STOPLIST widened to add 'ONE' after a real false positive: aspose-email-foss/Aspose.Email-FOSS-for-Python's candidate (an email library with no OneNote relevance) was flagged for a 'ONE'/'one' casing inconsistency purely because 'ONE' is a real registry format token (OneNote) that also happens to be the ordinary English number word, which always has genuine lowercase prose occurrences alongside any unrelated all-caps use elsewhere in the same file. Verified by test at landing time.

_UNQUALIFIED_DEPENDENCY_CLAIM_PATTERNS's self-contained-noun exclusion lookahead widened to tolerate one optional qualifying word before the excluded noun, after PWD-040's 'pattern' fix broke again on the same repository: aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose.PDF-FOSS-for-.NET's Quick Start prose later read 'the minimal, self-contained usage pattern for getting started', with 'usage' now inserted between 'self-contained' and 'pattern'. The lookahead required the excluded noun to immediately follow 'self-contained', so this one extra qualifying word wrongly flagged the sentence again as an absolute dependency-absence claim about the product. Verified by test at landing time.

provenance_note: 'sha256'/'aggregate_sha256' bind exact current vendored content, which for any file carrying a 'local_adaptations' entry no longer equals the pristine byte-for-byte content at 'source_commit' -- content-address integrity is still exact and verified by test_vendored_check_battery_matches_its_content_addressed_manifest; upstream-identity is exact only for files with no 'local_adaptations' entry. Decision (2026-08-27, GOV-032/requirement family): adopted, per master.md's own 'upstream defects are adapted... rather than inherited' policy, rather than reverting the local fix or silently overstating provenance.
qualification: Upstream checks are imported as evidence-bearing candidates. Local classification, fixtures, and bridge support decide whether each check is blocking, diagnostic, adaptation-required, or not applicable. Upstream controller state is never imported.
